# Return Request Tracker (RRT-001) Specification
      All claims for product replacements must be made within a 30-day warranty window.
      For any defective item, customers must upload photo proof before submission.
      Low-risk claims below $100 are automatically approved, while high-risk claims go to a CSR queue.
